title: Lodestone: Automated Semantic Discovery of Datacenter Hardware Specialization
abstract: arXiv:2611.23663v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hardware specialization can improve datacenter efficiency. Unfortunately, identifying computations that justify dedicated hardware is difficult. Existing approaches analyze hot functions, instruction patterns, or overheads such as datacenter tax. They can miss fine-grained computations whose aggregate cost is spread across applications and libraries, especially when different pieces of code obscure the same underlying computation. We observe that seemingly unrelated code regions often perform the same computations, creating specialization opportunities that require semantic reasoning. The rise of agentic AI makes it possible to automate this. However, conventional AI agents cannot efficiently and reliably analyze large scale datacenter software. To unlock this opportunity, we present Lodestone, an agentic framework that automatically discovers hardware specialization opportunities by reasoning about what the executed code computes. Fir

translated_title: Lodestone：数据中心硬件专业化的自动化语义发现
translated_abstract: 硬件专业化可以提升数据中心的效率。遗憾的是，识别出值得为其构建专用硬件的计算非常困难。现有方法通常分析热点函数、指令模式或诸如“数据中心税”之类的开销，因此可能会遗漏那些总体成本分散在各类应用和库中的细粒度计算，尤其是当不同的代码片段掩盖了相同的底层计算时。我们观察到，看似无关的代码区域往往执行着相同的计算，这产生了需要语义推理才能发现的硬件专业化机会。智能体 AI（agentic AI）的兴起使这一过程的自动化成为可能。然而，传统的 AI 智能体无法高效且可靠地分析大规模数据中心软件。为了抓住这一机会，我们提出了 Lodestone，一个智能体框架，它通过对执行代码所完成的计算进行语义推理，自动发现硬件专业化机会。
tldr: Lodestone 是一个基于智能体 AI 的框架，通过对代码所执行计算内容的语义推理，自动发现传统热点分析方法容易遗漏的、分散在各类应用和库中的数据中心硬件专业化机会。
en_tdlr: Lodestone is an agentic AI framework that automatically discovers datacenter hardware specialization opportunities by semantically reasoning about what executed code computes, uncovering fine-grained opportunities spread across applications and libraries that conventional hotspot-based approaches miss.
